contracts.anchor: printed p1 game and p3 A Winning Strategy
contracts.objects: y_t and prediction x_t are real numbers in [0,1]; t=1,...,T
contracts.feedback: y_t is revealed after x_t is chosen; p3 also allows adversary to choose y_t after observing x_t
contracts.stochasticity: No distribution, independence, or oblivious-adversary assumption for Theorem 1.3
contracts.horizon: Positive integer T, implicit in 1/T, round 1 and ln T; T=0 is not a printed theorem case

contracts.comparator: One fixed scalar u for the entire realized outcome sequence, optimized in hindsight
contracts.sign: Real signed difference; no nonnegativity assertion for this pathwise regret
contracts.quantifiers: Definition is evaluable on arbitrary prediction/outcome traces; causal realizability is a separate algorithm property
not_equivalent_to: min_u E[sum_t (u-Y_t)^2] inside a pathwise definition

contracts.anchor: printed p2 first display and equation (1.1) p1
contracts.scope: I.i.d. distribution over [0,1] context on p1, with optimal constant prediction population mean
contracts.boundary: The minimum is outside expectation; this is not E[pathwise regret]. Nonnegative claims on p1 concern the expected excess over variance, not arbitrary pathwise signed regret.

contracts.anchor: printed p2 general definition and Remark 1.1
contracts.objects: V subset R^d, x_t in V, l_t:V->R, arbitrary fixed u in V
contracts.no_regret: For every fixed u in V, lim(T->infinity) Regret_T(u)/T <= 0 (printed as lim, not limsup)
contracts.boundary: No change to limsup is attributed as literal source. Footnote permits prediction set W strictly containing V in some other settings.

contracts.quantifiers: T positive integer; every y_t in [0,1]
contracts.source_assertion: Printed as a scalar argmin equal to empirical mean, introduced as immediate. No calculation or attainment/uniqueness proof supplied.
contracts.required_characterization: Mean belongs to [0,1], attains minimum, and is the unique minimizer for positive T.
contracts.representation_boundary: A minimum value represented by loss at the mean, an existential attained-minimum predicate, a chosen argmin, and variance-decomposition algebra are library representations/derivations, not additional literal displayed definitions.

contracts.formula: x_t=xStar_(t-1)=(1/(t-1))*sum(i=1..t-1,y_i) for t>=2; x_1 any number in [0,1]
contracts.semantics: Strict past, not inclusive empirical mean. The xStar_t comparator sees y_t; actual prediction x_t does not.

assumptions: for every t=1,...,T, xStar_t in argmin(u in V,sum(i=1..t,l_i(u)))
contracts.boundary: Existence of minimizers is a source assumption of this general lemma. It must be discharged when specializing to squared loss; not added as an extra premise to Theorem 1.3.
contracts.proof: Induction on positive T with base 1 and equal final summands removed in inductive step.

contracts.anchor: printed p4 Theorem 1.3; proof p5 and opening p6
contracts.probability: Deterministic pathwise, for every allowed outcome sequence. No expectation or high-probability event.
contracts.strategy: Specific causal strategy, not arbitrary x trace. Universal trace theorem plus the stated strict-past formula supports adaptive adversary play.
contracts.constants: Natural logarithm; exactly 4 + 4 ln T; no minimax-optimality theorem is proved here.
contracts.horizon_boundary: Positive T only. An empty-sum T=0 definition or totalized real logarithm extension must be labeled an independent library extension.

contracts.boundary: At T=1 tail is empty and bound is 1/4. The 1/4 is not multiplied by T and tail starts at 2. Arbitrary initial x_1 does not inherit this constant.

derived_representations.obligation: Prove the C-MEAN characterization before identifying this value with the printed min over [0,1].
Useful possible proof of C-MEAN; not printed on pp2-6 and not counted as source-route completion.

derived_representations.formula: Equal strict-past histories imply equal x_t
derived_representations.obligation: Follows from the explicit prediction formula, but no formal policy type/history-recursion theorem is printed.

derived_representations.formula: Any T=0 conventions for mean, min value or regret
derived_representations.obligation: Positive-horizon source contract must remain visible; no arbitrary default may be presented as the literal positive-horizon mean characterization.
